artworks.title: Les Augures de l'Empire...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures wearing masks in front of a neoclassical building. The drawing depicts two figures standing before a building labeled "Assemblée Nationale," which resembles a Greek or Roman temple with its classic columns and pediment. The figures, clad in robes and wearing theatrical masks, are standing next to a cage labeled "Canards sacrés," or "Sacred Ducks," with several ducks poking their heads out from the bars. "Constitutionnel" is written on the ground in front of the cage. The style of the drawing is indicative of 19th-century political cartoons.

artworks.title: Lilliputiens essayant de profiter du sommeil...
artworks.description: This is an image of a drawing showing a large figure labeled "SUFFRAGE UNIVERSEL" restrained by small figures resembling Lilliputians from Gulliver's Travels. The small figures are using ropes and pegs to control and contain the large figure. In the background, there is a classical building to the left. In the foreground, there is text and artistic decorations on the ground. This illustration appears to be a political commentary or cartoon about universal suffrage being influenced or held back by multiple determined forces.

artworks.title: Les Fricoteurs politiques
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman surrounded by several men holding an object. The woman is holding a spoon and a book labeled "France" while inspecting a dish labeled "Loi Electorale" presented to her by the men. The men are caricatured with exaggerated facial features. The illustration suggests a political commentary on electoral law represented as a culinary dish. The drawing style is detailed with cross-hatching techniques.

artworks.title: Grandeur et décadence d'O. Barrot
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central winged figure looking displeased in the foreground, set against a playful scene in the background. The figure in the foreground has small wings on its back, exaggerated facial features, and is standing with crossed arms. In the background, there are multiple small figures engaged in a circle dance under a cloudy sky. The entire scene is framed with ornate details.

artworks.title: Les Malheurs du chimiste Dumas
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring a cherub-like figure interacting with various animal figures within a whimsically-framed scene. The central figure has wings and a human face, seen engaging with a horse behind vertical bars or a fence. To the left, a giraffe's head appears over a wire fence, and a dog with exaggerated features looks through the same fence. A bird in flight is positioned above the scene. The picture is bordered by ornate decorations and swirling motifs, and the use of line and shading adds movement and depth to the image.

artworks.title: Les Curieux Punis
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a surreal landscape scene with figures and structures. The drawing depicts a distorted figure with exaggerated facial expressions and limbs, seemingly running or in motion across a textured ground. Around the central figure, there are other forms that suggest movement or transformation. In the background, there are structures resembling towers or castles. The style uses shading and contrasts to create depth and emphasize the fantastical, otherworldly theme of the drawing.

artworks.title: Le Nid abandonné
artworks.description: This is a drawing of stylized figures in a nest. The scene depicts a group of figures seated in a large nest-like structure, with two winged figures approaching them. The figures are drawn with exaggerated features and expressions. In the background, there are rolling hills and an open sky. An ornate frame surrounds the scene. The drawing uses strong black and white contrasts.

artworks.title: Le Sommeil d'Endymion-Berryer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a wooded setting. The scene is framed in an ornate, Baroque-style border. In the center, there are two figures: one resembling a plump, reclining form with a draped fabric partially covering its lower half, while it leans back with eyes closed. The second figure appears to be a ghostly presence hovering above and to the side of the first. This spectral figure is rendered with lighter shading, giving it a translucent quality, and it seems to be gesturing upwards. The background is animated with dark, dense foliage, and there are beams of light that pierce through the overhead canopy, casting illumination onto the central figures. The style of the drawing is loose and fluid, characterized by flowing lines and contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: La Souscription Napoléonienne
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring two figures interacting near a doorway. The scene shows two people standing in a hallway. Both figures wear long coats and hold walking sticks. One figure is offering a hat through an open door. The setting is simplistic, with focus on the interaction at the threshold. The artwork emphasizes distinct lines and shading, giving the figures exaggerated features akin to caricatures. Simple architectural elements like a railing and a door are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Une Panique de Lilliputiens...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a giant figure labeled "Suffrage Universe" frightening smaller figures. The drawing depicts a large, powerful figure on the right side of the image, labeled with the words "SUFFRAGE UNIVERSE". This imposing figure is rising from the ground, which appears to be part of a manuscript or document. On the left side, smaller caricatured figures are shown scrambling away, with one figure's hat flying into the air. Their exaggerated expressions and body language convey a sense of panic or alarm. The image seems to be a satirical take on societal reactions to the concept of universal suffrage, possibly reflecting anxieties or opposition at the time. The style of drawing, with its use of caricature and symbolism, suggests it may be from the era of political cartoons aimed at commenting on social and political issues.

artworks.title: Regrets Superflus!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men observing a jar containing a conjoined figure. The drawing showcases a large jar labeled with the words "Feu La Fusion" and "Infusion à Perpétuité," housing a surreal conjoined figure that appears to be two heads sharing a single body and wearing crowns. The figures are looking at each other. The jar sits on a surface with some coins scattered around. To the right, two large-nosed men with solemn and concerned expressions look critically at the jar, hands clasped. The drawing suggests a caricature or a critique, likely aimed at societal or political themes.

artworks.title: Docteur... je ne suis pas aussi malade...
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman and a standing man. The man faces the woman with his body slightly angled towards the viewer. He wears a top hat, sideburns, a formal jacket, and tight-fitting trousers. The woman sits gracefully with long dark hair, wearing a simple dress and holding a shield-like object with "ASSEMBLEE NATIONALE" written on it. The background features minimalistic detailing.

artworks.title: Ce n'est pas encore cette fois-ci...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people reacting to a person walking with confidence. The scene features a figure on the right walking with a self-assured posture, with one hand inside their coat, while three figures on the left, behind a desk labeled "BANC DES MINISTRES," gesture with surprise or disapproval. The figure on the right is highlighted by radiating lines. The style of lines and shading gives a dramatic and satirical feel to the image.

artworks.title: Un Matamore portant une... botte...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure thrusting a sword into a document labeled "Constitution." The scene shows a character stabbing the ground with a sword, piercing a paper with the word "CONSTITUTION" written on it. The figure wears a pointed hat that obscures its head. The composition suggests movement with clothing and lines indicating motion, while shadows and shading add depth. Fine lines and hatching create texture and intensity.

artworks.title: Un Chemin dangereux
artworks.description: The image shows four men climbing up a steep incline. Each man has exaggerated facial features conveying a sense of struggle and urgency. The man at the top has a tall, pointed hairstyle and wears a dark suit. Below him, another man with a round face and balding head is holding onto the first man. The third man wears a conical hat and is being pulled up by the second man. At the bottom, a smaller figure appears to be slipping or falling, wearing a dark suit and an anxious expression. In the background, a figure stands atop a pedestal, covered in drapery with an inscription, and lines suggesting a landscape or clouds. The image is drawn in shades of gray and black with slight speckling on the paper.

artworks.title: Un Lutteur malheureux
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in various poses. One man is standing and leaning over another man who is seated on a chair. The seated man is thin, with pronounced cheekbones and an elongated face. He has sparse hair and is wearing striped shorts and slippers, without a shirt. The standing man wears a long dark coat, gloves, and a high hat. His face is expressive, with stylized hair and a shadow cast by the hat over his eyes. He holds a cane and a glistening object, possibly a light source, is aimed into the seated man's open mouth. A crumpled paper with text and a symbol is on the floor near the chair. The background is a simple light-toned surface, and the artwork is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast and shadow.

artworks.title: A Naples - Le meilleur des rois... (2nd plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a ledge, facing to the side with his hands resting on the ledge. He has a round face, prominent nose, short hair, and a crown with a fleur-de-lis. He wears a detailed uniform with medals and a sash. The background features a cityscape with tall buildings, swirling clouds in the sky, and human figures below, some moving and some lying still. The scene conveys a sense of depth and grandeur.

artworks.title: Hamlet
artworks.description: In the image, two individuals are shown in a dramatic pose. The first person, on the left, is depicted in a half-body profile with a crown on their head and long hair. They appear to be in shock or distress, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. The person on the right is facing them, holding a small jar. This individual has textured hair, wears a feathered cap, and a decorative garment with intricate details. The background of the image is plain, emphasizing the interaction between the characters.

artworks.title: Henri Monnier (Rôle de Joseph Prudhomme)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person standing with their left foot forward and their left hand stretched slightly outward. The person's posture is dynamic, leaning slightly back, and the head is turned upwards and to the right. The figure has rounded facial features with a prominent nose, large spectacles, and an open mouth. The hair is styled in a combed-back manner. The person is wearing a dark, formal jacket over a vest or waistcoat with prominent buttons, possibly accompanied by a cravat. The trousers are dark and striped, tapering down to looser fitting footwear. The background is shaded in an oval pattern, emphasizing the central character in a vintage print style.

artworks.title: La fusion
artworks.description: The image shows a tall cylindrical jar with smooth, curved lines containing an abstract figure inside. The figure consists of an amalgamation of shapes, resembling two humanoid forms conjoined at the torso, with exaggerated facial features, a small, distorted belly and limbs. Atop the heads of the conjoined figures is a rooster-like shape. The composition evokes a surrealistic creature or a jarred specimen.

artworks.title: La fusion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricatured figure inside a large glass jar. The drawing depicts a creature with two heads sharing a single body, positioned within a large container. A bird is perched atop one of the heads. The drawing style suggests it may be a satirical illustration, potentially exploring themes of fusion or amalgamation. The surrounding text and illustrative style resemble that of vintage editorial cartoons. The light, sketchy quality of the lines, along with the positioning of the creature, amplifies the whimsical and absurd nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Les saltimbanques
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricature-like scene with an exaggerated central figure and an audience. The image depicts a small figure in ragged clothing standing on a stage or platform, with one hand raised and the other slightly lowered. To the left, another figure is seen playing a drum. Surrounding these figures are numerous spectators with simple, expressive facial features. The figures are drawn with loose, sketch-like lines and shading that create a sense of texture and depth in the scene. The exaggerated proportions and features, particularly the central figure's bulbous head and elongated limbs, contribute to a satirical or humorous tone in the depiction.

artworks.title: Fruchard, en buste
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man seated, turned slightly towards his left. His facial features are exaggerated, with a large nose, pronounced chin, and furrowed brows. He has short, dark hair with distinct sideburns. He is dressed formally in a dark suit jacket and high-collared white shirt. The background is plain, and the drawing is in black and white. Below the image, the text reads "M. Fruch...."

artworks.title: Un nouveau nez
artworks.description: The image shows three adults and a baby. The baby is held in the arms of one of the adults. To the left, there is an older person with white hair tied back, wearing a long coat with intricate patterns. In the middle, a person is holding the baby, wearing a dark garment. To the right, a third person is lying in bed, covered with blankets and wearing a cap. The background includes ornate drapery, a bed with a detailed headboard, and a decorated teapot on a table beside the bed.
